solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Corrupt odd characters in boats in river

indicators.note: the second 'in' places the picked letters within the river's name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain, a favourite crossword river

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters (first, third, fifth) of the word boats are taken

explanation.surface: Something dodgy is going on aboard the boats moored in a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd characters in' picks B, A, S from 'boats'; the second 'in' sets them inside DEE.
explanation.definitionFit: To corrupt something is to degrade or lower its quality, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Shut up swapping components for item of plumbing

indicators.note: the two words of the phrase change places, so its front half goes to the back

parts.note: 'pipe down' is an informal order to be quiet

explanation.surface: An order to be quiet, then a trade's jargon reshuffled into a plumber's part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swapping components' exchanges the halves of PIPE DOWN.
explanation.definitionFit: A vertical pipe carrying rainwater from a gutter to a drain is a standard plumbing fitting.

clue.text: Complain and look grumpy making a bloomer

parts.note: to beef is slang for to grumble
to lower (or lour) is to scowl or frown

explanation.surface: Someone moaning and scowling after committing a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a bloomer' looks like a mistake but means a flower; LOWER here rhymes with 'flower' and means to scowl.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloomer is a flowering plant, and a bee-flower is one attractive to bees.

clue.text: One went in to join up

definitions.text: One went in to join up

indicators.note: the letter for one has gone into the middle of the joining word

parts.note: to solder is to join metal pieces together
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A recruit who signed up and went into the army.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a soldier is someone who went in to join up, i.e. enlisted.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who enlists in the army becomes a serving member of its ranks.

clue.text: Light colour deflecting from cue-ball

parts.note: a ball that glances away from another comes off it
in snooker and billiards the cue ball is the white

explanation.surface: A snooker player's ball glances off the cue ball.
explanation.walkthrough: In snooker, a British table game, the white is the ball struck with the cue.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale shade with a faint tint of grey or yellow is a light colour name used for paints.

clue.text: Careful of upsetting mate, one may be lucky

indicators.note: upsetting overturns the arrangement of the letters of the words careful of

parts.note: a mate or partner can be a lover

explanation.surface: A warning to tread carefully so as not to annoy one's partner.
explanation.definitionFit: A rare clover sprig bearing an extra leaf is a traditional charm for good fortune.

clue.text: Conflict to remove Parry

parts.note: war is armed conflict
to doff is to take off, especially a hat

explanation.surface: A war launched to get rid of someone called Parry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Parry' with its capital looks like a surname; it is the fencing verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To parry a blow is to deflect or fend it off, an idiomatic phrasal verb.

clue.text: Something to keep one warm — undergarment short at both ends

indicators.note: the vest word loses its first and its last letter

parts.note: a singlet is a sleeveless vest

explanation.surface: A vest too small at top and bottom, worn to stay warm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short at both ends' trims S and T from SINGLET.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingle is a domestic fireplace or hearth, which keeps people warm.

clue.text: Pass silently asleep, tossing

indicators.note: a restless sleeper tossing about suggests the letters of asleep being thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone drifts by in their sleep, tossing and turning.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that goes by unnoticed simply slips away, which is what the verb describes.

clue.text: Scruffy person, awfully maltreated one in a fashion

indicators.note: the jumbled letters sit within the word for fashion

parts.note: the ton is the prevailing fashion, from French

indicators.note: awfully says the letters of maltreated plus the numeral are in a terrible mess

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A ragged person, badly treated, still trying to be fashionable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awfully' makes the anagram ATTERDEMALI; 'in' sets it inside. 'The ton' is an old term for high society and its fashions.
explanation.definitionFit: A ragamuffin dressed in tattered clothes is the literal sense of this old word.

clue.text: Execute turn with back of foot

parts.note: the heel is the rear part of the foot

explanation.surface: A dancer pivoting on a heel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Execute' tempts as kill; it simply means perform.
explanation.definitionFit: To wheel is to pivot or swing round, as soldiers or birds do.

clue.text: It can dissolve metal as used in many tanks

indicators.note: the abbreviation is put inside the word for fish tanks

parts.note: aquaria is the plural of aquarium, a fish tank
e.g. (for example) can stand for 'as' in 'such as'

explanation.surface: A corrosive liquid poured into a fleet of tanks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tanks' suggests armour; these are fish tanks.
explanation.definitionFit: This mixture of nitric and hydrochloric acids is famous for dissolving gold and platinum.

clue.text: Who'll tell future for friend with obscurity

parts.note: a pal is a friend
mist obscures vision

explanation.surface: A fortune teller gazing into the fog with a companion.
explanation.definitionFit: A palm reader claims to foretell someone's fate from the lines of the hand.

clue.text: This could give you nasty lesions

definitions.text: This could give you nasty lesions

indicators.note: nasty signals that the letters of lesions are messed up into another order

explanation.surface: A warning about an animal whose claws could wound you badly.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also defines: a big cat's claws inflict wounds.
explanation.definitionFit: A female big cat can maul a person, leaving painful wounds.

clue.text: Where to do early business with e.g. electricity cut quickly

parts.note: electricity is a form of power
a break is a cut or interruption
fast means quickly

explanation.surface: A sudden power cut interrupting a morning's work.
explanation.definitionFit: Executives hold deal-making meetings over the first meal of the day.

clue.text: Rested funerary vessel in earth grave

parts.note: sat means rested
an urn holds ashes
E is the abbreviation for earth in electrics

explanation.surface: An urn left resting in the soil of a grave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grave' looks like a noun in the burial scene; it is the adjective serious.
explanation.definitionFit: Saturnine describes a gloomy, solemn temperament, close to grave and sombre.

clue.text: Large plant producing drug in Tennessee

indicators.note: the drug word sits within the state's postal abbreviation

parts.note: TN is the US postal code for Tennessee
a reefer is a cannabis cigarette

explanation.surface: A big plant grown in Tennessee for its narcotic yield.
explanation.definitionFit: A fern growing a tall trunk-like stem is a sizeable plant of tropical forests.

clue.text: Cheese stall with starter portions of feta, Edam, Neufchatel wrapped in film

indicators.note: the first letters are enclosed between the cheese and the stall words

parts.note: Brie is a French cheese
a counter is a stall or stand where goods are sold

indicators.note: the opening letters of feta, Edam and Neufchatel are taken

explanation.surface: A cheese counter display with samples of three cheeses, all wrapped in cling film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film' looks like cling wrap; it is the 1945 David Lean film.
explanation.definitionFit: This celebrated 1945 British romance by David Lean is a classic movie.

clue.text: Give attention to home — it's serious

parts.note: to give ear is to listen attentively
a nest is a home

explanation.surface: Listen up about home affairs: it's a serious matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnest and serious both describe a sincere, solemn manner.

clue.text: Newcomer's got celebrity awfully put out

indicators.note: out means the scrambled letters lie outside the celebrity word
awfully says the three letters of put are badly jumbled

parts.note: a star is a celebrity

explanation.surface: A newcomer has upset a famous person badly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awfully' jumbles a short word into UPT; 'out' sets it around the celebrity, and 'Newcomer's got' reads as 'newcomer has'.
explanation.definitionFit: An upstart is a person who has suddenly risen in status, often presumptuously, a new arrival.

clue.text: Had been unruly youngster in the 50s, high on drugs

parts.note: was is a past form of be
a Ted, or Teddy boy, was a British youth of the 1950s

explanation.surface: A 1950s tearaway who used to be stoned.
explanation.walkthrough: Teddy boys were 1950s British youths with Edwardian-style suits and a rowdy name.
explanation.definitionFit: Wasted is slang for heavily intoxicated by drink or drugs.

clue.text: Potentially ratable land

indicators.note: the letters of ratable could potentially become another word when reordered

explanation.surface: Land that might be liable to property tax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'land' is a territory: a province of Canada.
explanation.definitionFit: Alberta is a western Canadian province, a region of land.

clue.text: Place providing accommodation with fairly low council tax

definitions.meaning: a bed and breakfast offers rooms for guests
UK council tax is levied in bands from A upwards

explanation.surface: A guest house paying modest local taxes.
explanation.walkthrough: Council tax is the British local property tax, banded by home value from A (lowest) upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A bed-and-breakfast offers overnight lodging; read as two words it is band B of the tax scale.

clue.text: Watch outside broadcast function

parts.note: OB is the broadcasting abbreviation for outside broadcast
to serve is to function or act

explanation.surface: Viewers tune in to watch an outside broadcast of an event.
explanation.definitionFit: To observe is to watch carefully, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Fork point snags a North German fruit

indicators.note: snags means catches, so the prong word catches the other letters inside it

parts.note: a tine is a prong of a fork

explanation.surface: A fork prong snagging a piece of fruit from northern Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: This loose-skinned orange citrus is a variety of mandarin.

clue.text: Put by the main track

definitions.meaning: set apart or saved for later
the featured song on a single's front, the A-side

explanation.walkthrough: On a vinyl single, the A-side carried the intended hit, with the B-side the lesser track.
explanation.definitionFit: To put something aside is to reserve it; an A-side is a record's lead song.

clue.text: One starting as worker after University in arrears

indicators.note: after says the worker word follows the rest
the university letter goes inside the word for arrears

parts.note: money in arrears is a debt
an ant is the classic crossword worker insect

explanation.surface: A new graduate starting work while in debt.
explanation.definitionFit: A debutant is someone making a first appearance, a newcomer just beginning.

clue.text: Scattered right round in all directions

indicators.note: the turned letters go inside the four compass letters

parts.note: S, E, W and N are the four compass points

indicators.note: round signals the abbreviation for right is turned about

explanation.surface: Things scattered right round in every direction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' turns the abbreviation into TR; the compass points can be taken in any order.
explanation.definitionFit: Strewn means spread untidily over an area, a past participle like scattered.
